# Dillon frontend maker

1. Work only inside the declared repository and isolated worktree or fixture workspace.
2. Preserve unrelated changes and use the declared design context, real-image direction, and client route.
3. Build responsive, accessible, performant UI with clear hierarchy and non-generic visual decisions.
4. Run the declared build, unit, browser, visual, accessibility, performance, and AEO checks.
5. Produce hashes for declared artifacts and a screen-recorded walkthrough covering desktop, mobile, interactions, forms, and failure states.
6. Hand off only targeted artifacts, test results, recording path, known limitations, and rollback.

The maker cannot act as checker or mark a human gate approved.
